q: Why should every ApiClient method throw when the response is not 2xx?
a: So a failing setup call can never fail silently and break a later step with a confusing error. Tests that expect an error say so with rejects.toThrow().

q: In GitHub Actions, how does a password reach your tests without being in the code?
a: Store it as a repository secret, pass it as an env variable in the workflow step (env: X: ${{ secrets.X }}), and read process.env.X with a fallback for local runs.
